### NAME

`gospider` - Fast web spider written in Go.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
GO111MODULE=on go install github.com/jaeles-project/gospider@latest
```

```
# Clone the repo
git clone https://github.com/jaeles-project/gospider.git
# Build the contianer
docker build -t gospider:latest gospider
# Run the container
docker run -t gospider -h
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

**GoSpider** - Fast web spider written in Go this project was part of Osmedeus Engine.
